text: Did you know if you soak chia seeds in warm water for 10 minutes, then add flax seeds,
almond flour, 3 eggs, a pinch of salt, and baking powder.
Blend it all together, top with pumpkin seeds, bake 40 minutes, and you get a hearty seed
bread with no regular flour and won't spike your blood sugar.
